text:
Ari Gomez: quick heads-up: two small docs PRs landed that need a reviewer and a merge slot today. low-risk but blocking a customer migration demo.
Priya Patel: drop links?
Ari Gomez: PRs: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/401 (sdk-examples update), https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/402 (link-correct for v2 routing). previews attached.
Hector Ramos: i'm on call but can take one in the 11:30 merge window. which one is more urgent?
Ari Gomez: #401 is blocking a sample repo used in the demo, so higher priority. #402 is just a 302 -> 301 redirect fix.
Lina Voss: I'll pick up #401. PTA: check code fences, run snippets locally, and confirm the examples build. assign me pls.
Priya Patel: assigning Lina to #401. Hector, want #402? tiny redirect, should be quick.
Hector Ramos: assigned, will patch redirect header to 301 and run linkcheck.
docs-ci-bot: [preview] build queued for PR #402...
ops-deploy-bot: note: merge window at 11:30-12:15 today per release calendar.
Lina Voss: found one failing snippet in #401  a missing import in the Python example. posting quick fix in the branch.```\nfrom redwood import RedwoodClient\nclient = RedwoodClient()\n```
Lina Voss: preview: https://deploy-preview-401--redwood-docs.netlify.app/sdk/examples
docs-ci-bot: [preview] linkcheck error on #402  found relative link to /docs/old-routing (404)
Hector Ramos: that 404 comes from an outdated anchor; switching it to /docs/routing-v2#overview and force-pushing.
Priya Patel: small process note: docs rotation today shows no dedicated reviewer after lunch. should we adopt a "micro-harvest" approach for <5-line PRs? i.e., one person nukes a batch. thoughts?
Ari Gomez: micro-harvest sounds good. can we add a tiny label "harvest-ok" for PRs that qualify? then rosters can filter.
Priya Patel: created label: harvest-ok. please tag when appropriate.
Hector Ramos: pushed redirect fix and updated link. re-running preview.
docs-ci-bot: [preview] deploy succeeded for PR #402  https://deploy-preview-402--redwood-docs.netlify.app/guides/routing-v2
Lina Voss: finished snippet fix and smoke-tested the example locally. ready for an approval.
Priya Patel: approval checklist: preview link valid, snippets run, changelog entry if breaking. for both PRs non-breaking so no changelog needed.
Hector Ramos: approving #402.
Lina Voss: approving #401. merging now in the 11:30 window.
ops-deploy-bot: merged PR #401 by Lina Voss at 11:33. CI: green.
ops-deploy-bot: merged PR #402 by Hector Ramos at 11:36. CI: green.
Ari Gomez: nailed it, thanks everyone. Priyas harvest suggestion implemented; i'll open a tiny RFC for 'harvest-ok' policy tomorrow. closing thread.
Priya Patel: thanks all :rocket:
